snippet.title: How I Got Fluent in French FAST — My Daily Routine
snippet.description:
I struggled to speak French for years—until I discovered 6 key strategies that transformed my learning. In just one year, I became fluent before ever going to France.

In this video, I break down my daily French learning routine step by step, including methods for:

Pronunciation: Shadowing native speakers
Reading: Recording yourself to improve fluency
Grammar: One lesson a day for solid foundations
Listening: Watching native content effectively
Speaking: Practicing on your own and with native speakers
Consistency: How daily habits accelerate learning

Even if you’re learning another language, these techniques work for any language and are designed to help you build real-world skills from home.

Click here for the story of how I learned French: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CGlEAr6kaMA&t=7s

✨ Resources & Tools I Mention:
HugoDécrypte (YouTube) - https://www.youtube.com/@hugodecrypteactus
Le Monde (news articles) - https://www.lemonde.fr/
WordReference (vocabulary & grammar help) - https://www.wordreference.com/
Difficultés du français for English speakers (my grammar textbook - note all explanations are in French) - https://www.amazon.com/Difficult%C3%A9s-du-fran%C3%A7ais-English-speakers/dp/209033701X/ref=sr_1_2?crid=1XC8UPN2BGXPU&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.EgpuCLvI2bVZuzIa6J5WaUhmj1X6bsY7UQJSb2Ab3nA3VXZ9LQfyoXe_L-qP_MHxtz3T2R1PI1q13tqDTztR_SU1VmkuvDUhwxaXMV3DE34.NKSoyzLalKS9hKTunebG2S0KTawMJGHGHC-VWZ8GMlI&dib_tag=se&keywords=difficultes+expliquees+du+francais&qid=1767392200&sprefix=difficulte%2Caps%2C147&sr=8-2
iTalki (tutors & conversation practice) - https://www.italki.com/

Whether you’re a beginner or aiming for fluency, this routine shows you how to improve reading, listening, grammar, and speaking in a practical, consistent way.
